text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, aztreonam 1 g injection is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 261 vials at 13.2 vials per day (19.8 days on hand). Corvale General holds 255 vials at 15.4 vials per day (16.5 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 42 vials at 4.1 vials per day (10.1 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows aztreonam is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers all sites for 10 to 20 days. No FDA shortage exists, but Lakeside supply is the tightest. Three alternate manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C. (Princeton plant) as first alternate; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (VAI inspection 2023-10-13) as second alternate; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Hospira, Inc. as third alternate; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage at all three sites and report weekly to P&T committee; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
